title: Lock screen should clear the password entered when left idle
line: A password typed on the lock screen but never submitted is now cleared when the prompt fades out after a few seconds of inactivity.
explanation: The lock screen hides its prompt after 10 seconds without input, but it kept whatever had been typed in the password field, so a half-typed or forgotten password stayed there indefinitely. With the pointer over the screen, a non-empty field even stopped the prompt from fading out at all. Now the fade-out also clears the password, typing restarts the idle timer so slow typing is never interrupted, and a non-empty field no longer keeps the prompt up forever.

commits.message:
lockscreen: clear the password when left idle

A password typed but never submitted stayed in the field forever, and it
even kept the prompt from fading out while the pointer was over it. Now
the prompt fades out after the usual idle time and clears the password.

BUG: 434321

media.caption: Master: a password is typed on the lock screen.
Fix: same, a password is typed.
Master: 13 s later with no input, the prompt is still shown with the password in it.
Fix: 13 s later the prompt has faded back to the clock.
Master: waking the screen again, the old password is still there.
Fix: waking the screen again shows an empty password field.

reviews.text: Reusing the idle fade-out in `LockScreenUi.qml` to clear an unsubmitted password is a reasonable direction, but the patch introduces two concrete regressions. First, `fadeoutTimer` is never stopped when `uiVisible` becomes `false` (and `onBlockUIChanged` restarts it even when `!uiVisible`), so on multi-monitor setups moving to a second screen leaves the first screen's timer running; typing on the second screen does not restart the first screen's timer (guarded by `lockScreenRoot.uiVisible`), causing the first screen to fire `root.clearPassword()` and wipe the password mid-typing. Second, after removing `mainPasswordBox.text.length > 0` from `blockUI`, only `onTextChanged` restarts `fadeoutTimer`, so active non-text interactions (moving the pointer, toggling Show Password, switching keyboard layouts, or using arrow/Tab keys) will still have the prompt fade out and clear the password 10 seconds after the last character typed.
changes: Stop `fadeoutTimer` whenever `!uiVisible` in `onUiVisibleChanged`, guard `fadeoutTimer.restart()` in `onBlockUIChanged` with `else if (uiVisible)`, and check `lockScreenRoot.uiVisible` in `fadeoutTimer.onTriggered` so an inactive monitor's timer cannot clear the password while the user is typing on another monitor; test on a two-output setup.

Restart `fadeoutTimer` on non-text user interaction (pointer movement/presses, non-text key presses such as arrows/Tab, Show Password toggle, keyboard layout switching) or use a proper activity handler / longer password-clear timeout so users are not interrupted mid-interaction.
